system.description:
If they try to ignore your touch, they rot. The Eidolon of Suffering makes every escape a punishment, stacking conditions on a Soul Touched foe and feeding on the pain it endures.

LEVEL 3

Soul of Suffering. Choose the stat unwilling targets use to save against your Soul Touched.

Suffering Rites. A Rite menu (Meekness, Corrupt) that daze and impair.

LEVEL 7

Rotting Flesh. An enemy that saves to remove Soul Touched is Poisoned, 1 round.

LEVEL 11

Feed the Corruption. While Soul Touched, gaining a negative condition grants STR temp HP and lets you inflict the same condition on an enemy in Reach 8.

LEVEL 15

Poltergeist. (1/Round) Using a Soul or Suffering Rite can also use Haunt on that target for free.
